roles_start.title: Co-founder & Developer
roles_start.description: Solo development of the management app (PWA, JavaScript, Supabase): appointments, invoicing, client follow-up, PDF invoices/quotes/credit notes and data extraction from PDF invoices. Automated tests (Vitest, Playwright) and GitHub Actions CI. Client acquisition via Meta Ads, Google Ads and social media: 100+ invoiced clients, including professionals and mid-sized companies.

roles_start.title: Dev & Data Project Manager (Digitalization)
roles_start.description: Found no usable internal data (stock, service and locker room tracked orally or on paper), so built the tool that produces it first. Independently designed and developed a PWA (Supabase/PostgreSQL, Row Level Security) for structured, timestamped tracking of stock, tasks (with photo proof) and lockers (QR code), with the help of an AI coding assistant (Claude Code). In production, used by 20+ people.
